svg.aria-label: Side-by-side comparison of a local-only tap path and a network-dependent tap path.
svg.title: FIG-CH02-005: Local vs Network-Dependent Tap
svg.desc: Two columns share the human/input/OS prefix. The left column stays on device. The right column adds socket/API, packets, access network, and remote service before rejoining at render/perception.
svg.text: Status: conceptual · Representative educational diagram · Color is not the sole encoding
1. Left: local-only path ends at application/renderer
2. Right: network-dependent path continues to packets and service
3. Both share initial sensing and OS delivery
